newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-DALGLISH SIGNS PORTUGUESE DEFENDER RAUL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DALGLISH SIGNS PORTUGUESE DEFENDER RAUL.

text.p: Newcastle manager Kenny Dalglish has made his first move to shore up the premier league's side's porous defence by signing Portuguese under-21 international Raul from Farense on a free transfer.
Former Liverpool and Blackburn manager Dalglish took over at Newcastle last week after Kevin Keegan resigned on January 8.
Newcastle have taken 2-0 leads in their last two league outings against Aston Villa and Southampton only to see their opponents come back on each occasion to snatch a 2-2 draw.
Assistant-manager Terry McDermott said Raul, 22, would be given until the end of the season to prove himself.
"We're bringing in Raul and once he's here, there's a chance that there will be another player coming in," McDermott said.

"I don't know much about him. Kenny's brought him in and thinks he will be a good acquisition for us. He will be with us until the end of the season, so that gives him plenty of time to bed in and he gives us more scope at centre-half."
